scope: 26 prepared findings plus 14 distinct residual/qualification records; two retained residual IDs alias F24/F25. Not a complete defect inventory.

definitions.source_confirmed: A defective source operation and reachable caller or violated invariant were traced; no runtime execution is implied.
definitions.patched: A remedy exists in the prepared diff; compilation, regression success and baseline detection are not implied.
definitions.ci_verified: A named scenario passed on an exact patch revision and named platform/configuration with linked CI evidence; record baseline or mutation failure separately. This never automatically closes the record.
definitions.observed_failure: A linked prior CI run failed; its cause and applicability to a proposed fix remain to be established.
definitions.reported: An upstream symptom is catalogued without current Groundzero reproduction.
definitions.needs_investigation: A boundary was traced but impact, exploitability or intended policy remains unresolved.
definitions.qualification_gap: Required platform, artifact or workflow evidence is missing.
definitions.priority: P1 prioritizes crash/edit-loss/wrong-artwork risk or investigation of such risk; P2 narrower reliability or qualification work. Not CVSS.
definitions.resolution: All records remain open. Only explicit review of required evidence and compatibility decisions may change resolution.
definitions.follow_up_patch: A separately prepared patch is reported but is not part of the reviewed snapshot until its integration and exact revision are recorded.
definitions.tracked_in_finding: Stable residual ID retained as an alias after a follow-up remedy joins the prepared findings; do not count it again or infer runtime closure.

closure_requires: baseline or targeted mutation detects defect
evidence_policy.proposed_tests: Empty tests arrays and pending items describe missing coverage, not implemented features.
evidence_policy.source_paths: Repository-relative paths. For reported or coverage-gap records, paths identify candidate/qualification scope, not proof of a defect.

ffmpeg_public.limit: Requires an FFmpeg/ffprobe pair; helper resolution checks do not require Rhubarb.

ffmpeg_direct.limit: Direct classes are not exported for the MSVC fixture.

native_tasks.limit: Application fixture, not a separately registered CTest; earlier native crashes can prevent reaching its checkpoints.

native_vector.limit: Require --require-vector-workflows and retain the native checkpoint log.

deformer.limit: Numeric fixtures do not establish complete old-scene rendering equivalence.

autopatch.limit: Header helpers only; the Fx dry/compute and predictive subdivision paths need a separate fixture.

externfx.limit: Validates process/decoder outcomes, not assignment of decoded pixels to the tile.

plugin_probe.limit: Private real native module; qualify Qt 5 and Qt 6 explicitly.

ci_audit.limit: Mocked API boundaries; live reporter observations are recorded separately in the main audit.

ci_budget.limit: Static topology model; observed historical/manual check totals are different quantities.

findings.title: PSD overwrite transaction
findings.baseline_behavior: Opening the destination with wb truncates old artwork before a short write or close failure.
findings.patched_invariant: Publish only fully written, flushed temporary output; preserve the original on failure.

validation.mutation_proposal: Restore the constructor's shared setLayerId update and shared-ID load; the interleaving case must fail.
